Package org.jlab.coda.cedit.parsers.extconfig

Class AbstractConfigReader

java.lang.Object
org.jlab.coda.cedit.parsers.extconfig.AbstractConfigReader
Direct Known Subclasses:
EmuConfigReader, RocConfigReader
public abstract class AbstractConfigReader extends Object
Abstract base class for configuration file readers. Provides common functionality for reading component configuration files from the CODA configuration directory structure. Subclasses implement the actual parsing logic for different file formats.
